author: Paul Rubillo
title: Equity Market Update for 11/2/18
text:
Equity Market Update for 11/2/18 47pm NYSE:DIA
Market technician Dave Chojnacki of StreetOne Technical Analysis dives into the technicals for the major U.S. averages.
Decent Economic reports on Thursday set the stage for equities to open higher for the third straight session. Tech stocks were strong again, with the FANG stocks making up some of their recent losses. Even AMZN had a good day, which has been weak recently. Equities began to lose some strength in the morning, but a tweet by the President gave the market an extra push. President Trump tweeted that he spoke with the Chinese Pres. Xi, and that trade talks are moving along. After the bell, AAPL reported, disappointing sales and guidance had their shares trading down 7% after the bell. The major indices closed the session with significant gains. The 10YR ended the day at 3.14.
At the close on Thursday, the DJIA was up 1%, the SPX added 1%, and the NDX gained 1.4%. Breadth was decidedly positive, 3 to 1, on average volume. ROC(10)’s advanced in the session, with the DJIA crossing into positive territory. The NDX and SPX advanced but remained in negative territory. RSI’s moved higher, with the DJIA now leading at 48.7. The SPX ended the day at 45.6 and the NDX at 47.4. All three major indices remain with their MACD below signal. The ARMS index ended the day at 1.23, a slightly bearish close.
It was the third straight session to the upside, as the major averages attempt to bounce off their recent lows. Several near term technicals are improving, but strong volume is missing, adding little conviction to the recent move. The DJIA is showing the best strength of the big three. It closed at 25380, 5 points above its 20D-SMA(25375). It also moved back above its 200D-SMA of 25128. The DJIA remains below its 50% retrace level of 25494. The NDX closed at 7069, just 1 point above its 200D-SMA of 7068. It remains below its 20D-SMA of 7080. The NDX did move above its 50% retrace level of 7059. The SPX ended the day at 2740, remaining below its 200D-SMA of 2765. It continues below its 20D-SMA of 2756. It continues below its 50% retrace level of 2755. The VIX finished at 19.34, down 8.9%. Near term support for the NDX is at 7059 and 6816. Near term resistance is at 7080 and 7200. Near term support for the SPX is at 2700 and 2685. Near term resistance is at 2756 and 2765. Europe is higher in early trade. US Futures are significantly higher premarket.
The SPDR Dow Jones Industrial Average ETF Trust WATCH LIST CREATE DIA ALERT ( DIA ) was trading at $251.46 $2.27 (-0.89%). Year-to-date, DIA has gained 2.50%, versus a 1.83% rise in the benchmark S&P 500 index during the same period.
